title: Clue, Revelation, Mystery & Investigation Design
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Clue, Revelation, Mystery and Investigation Design over the MAS-01..05 foundations, using explicit owner-domain and prepared Quest/route references while preserving canonical Investigation, Knowledge and runtime authority and ensuring prepared clues or revelations never prove discovery or reveal state.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared clue, revelation, mystery and investigation design inside the MAS workspace without duplicating canonical Investigation/Knowledge/runtime state or treating authored/reachable information as discovered or revealed live truth.
included: explicit owner and MAS-05 Quest/Objective/Task references
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically author clues, revelations, mysteries and investigations over prepared MAS-01..05 material with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states, while preserving canonical Investigation/Knowledge/runtime authority and never treating prepared clues or revelations as discovered, revealed or resolved live truth.

selection_boundaries: Existing MAS validation family remains active; no family transition is authorized or required.

MAS-01 workspace/document authority, MAS-02 higher-order structure, MAS-03 prepared assembly, MAS-04 prepared nonlinear graph and MAS-05 prepared Quest authoring remain foundational and are not reopened silently.

Clues, revelations, mysteries and investigation structures are prepared authoring semantics; canonical Investigation, Knowledge and runtime owner domains retain discovery, reveal, resolution and mutation authority.
Authored, linked or reachable clues/revelations never prove that information was discovered, revealed, understood or that a mystery/investigation was resolved.
MAS-07 retains Cast, NPC Agenda, Relationship & Callback Planning scope and must not be pulled forward.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-07+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: On the authorized application branch, establish causal MAS-06 RED against deterministic prepared Clue/Revelation/Mystery/Investigation behavior, then implement the minimum contract without reopening MAS-01..05 authority boundaries.
